No network operations, file manipulations, or system modifications are performed by `.SRCINFO` itself.

The package depends on standard system libraries and services (dbus, systemd, upower, etc.), which are reasonable for a GPU/system management tool using eBPF. There is no evidence of obfuscated URLs, unexpected downloads, or malicious behavior indicators. The file adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and presents no signs of supply chain compromise.
